description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including user creation, login, fetching current user data, and updating user information. It imports external middleware and services to handle requests.

methods.name: router.post('/users')
methods.description: Handles user creation by calling createUser with request data and returning the created user.

methods.name: router.post('/users/login')
methods.description: Handles user login by calling login with user data from request body.

methods.name: router.get('/user')
methods.description: Fetches current user information using getCurrentUser based on authentication info.

methods.name: router.put('/user')
methods.description: Updates user information with data from request body and authenticated user ID.

ctags.name: user
ctags.pattern: /^    const user = await createUser({ ...req.body.user, demo: false });$/
